name: Push Up
description: A classic bodyweight exercise that targets the chest, shoulders, and triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: A lower-body exercise that improves leg strength and stability.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
Bend your knees and lower your hips.
Push through your feet to return to standing.

name: Plank
description: An isometric exercise that strengthens the core and improves stability.
instructions: Start on your forearms and toes.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Engage your core.
Hold the position for the desired duration.

name: Lunges
description: A unilateral leg exercise that builds strength and balance.
instructions: Stand upright with your feet together.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent.
Push back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
description: An isolation exercise designed to strengthen and build the biceps.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Slowly lower them back down.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: An effective exercise for developing shoulder strength and stability.
instructions: Sit or stand with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press them overhead.
Lower them slowly back to shoulder level.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: A dynamic cardio exercise that targets the core and lower body.
instructions: Start in a high plank position.
Bring one knee toward your chest.
Quickly switch legs.
Continue alternating at a steady pace.

name: Burpees
description: A full-body exercise that combines strength and cardiovascular training.
instructions: Start standing with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Return your feet forward and jump upward.

name: Glute Bridge
description: A simple exercise for strengthening the glutes and posterior chain.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Place your feet flat on the floor.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips slowly.

name: Jumping Jacks
description: A simple cardio exercise that increases heart rate and warms up the body.
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Jump while spreading your legs.
Raise your arms overhead.
Jump back to the starting position.

name: Deadlift
description: A compound strength exercise that targets the posterior chain.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Place the barbell close to your shins.
Bend your hips and knees to grip the bar.
Lift the bar while keeping your back neutral.
Lower the bar under control.

name: Bench Press
description: A compound upper-body exercise focused mainly on the chest.
instructions: Lie flat on the bench.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the bar toward your chest.
Press the bar upward until your arms are extended.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: A pulling exercise that develops the back and improves upper-body strength.
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position.

name: Russian Twist
description: A core exercise that focuses on the abdominal muscles and obliques.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent.
Lean your upper body slightly backward.
Keep your core engaged.
Rotate your torso from side to side.

name: Leg Press
description: A machine-based exercise for building strength in the lower body.
instructions: Sit on the leg press machine.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Lower the platform by bending your knees.
Push the platform away without locking your knees.
